dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature (falcate) measured from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, resulting in a slightly pointed tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steepness of approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve indicating a smooth, rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length relative to its thickness, presenting a robust beak morphology.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140-150 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularities and small nicks visible along the leading edge of the dorsal fin and subtle linear markings on the flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined dark dorsal cape pattern and visible eye with surrounding orbital detail.
